user.description: Enter the serial port path for your Schellenberg USB stick.

usb_confirm.description: Confirm the serial port path for your discovered Schellenberg USB stick.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the serial port

user.title: Pair Device
user.description: Press the Pair button below, and then either press the pairing button on the device OR press the programming button on your already-paired remote control and afterwards send a stop command on your already-paired remote control to the motor you want to pair.

name_device.title: Name your device
name_device.description: A pairing candidate was detected, and the USB stick teach command was sent for device ID {device_id}. The stick ACK does not prove that the device authorized this. Name the device and then check the actual movement of the shutter.

calibration_close.title: Before you start
calibration_close.description: To calibrate {device_name} accurately, Home Assistant needs to know which shutter movement direction should be calibrated first.

data.initial_state: What is the shutter's current state?

calibration_open_instruction.title: Open the shutter
calibration_open_instruction.description: Now we will measure how long it takes to open {device_name}. Press Start **and then** the open button on the control to start the measurement. The calibration only starts when an upward movement message from the shutter has been transmitted to Home Assistant and subsequently processed by Home Assistant.

calibration_close_instruction.title: Close the shutter
calibration_close_instruction.description: Now we will measure how long it takes to close {device_name}. Press Start **and then** the close button on the control to start the calibration. The calibration only starts when a downward movement message from the shutter has been transmitted to Home Assistant and subsequently processed by Home Assistant.

calibration_timeout_choice.title: No response from the shutter
calibration_timeout_choice.description: Home Assistant did not detect the expected movement in time. Try again, or enter the travel times manually instead.

calibration_complete.title: Calibration complete

test_motor.title: Test motor command
test_motor.description: Choose a shutter movement direction and then press Test: The shutter moves briefly in this shutter movement direction and then stops automatically again. This addresses device {device_id}/{device_enum}. Watch the shutter while doing this {retry_notice}.

data.test_direction: Which shutter movement direction should be tested?

did_motor_move.title: Did the shutter move?
did_motor_move.description: Command identity {device_id}/{device_enum} tested: briefly {test_action}, then stopped.

test_success.title: Command test successful
test_success.description: The motor test confirmed the shutter moves. Continue to measure its travel times.

manual_times.title: Enter travel times
manual_times.description: Enter the measured full opening and closing times.

data.initial_state: What is the shutter's current state?

copy_diagnostics.title: Copy the diagnostics above
copy_diagnostics.description: Select and copy the diagnostic text below. Then press Return.

edit.title: Edit device settings
edit.description: Changing the protocol identities does not change the unique entity ID in Home Assistant. The primary status identity controls position tracking. Enter additional identities as device ID/enum, separated by one or more lines, or by one or more commas. Secondary identities are matched for diagnostics purposes, but do not change position. Leave both primary status fields blank if they are unknown; the transmit identity will not be used as status unless it was actually observed or you enter it manually.

teach_motor.submit: Send teach-in command to device and test

send_raw_command.title: Send raw RF telegram to the device

error.invalid_device_id: Device ID must contain exactly 6 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_device_enum: Enum value must contain exactly 2 hexadecimal characters.
error.invalid_travel_time: Travel time must be greater than zero.
error.initial_state_required: Please select whether the shutter is currently fully open or fully closed before proceeding.
error.test_direction_required: Please select which shutter movement direction should be tested before proceeding.
error.calibration_timeout: The calibration timer has expired. The shutter took more than 2 minutes for the movement. Please check the device and try again.
error.calibration_start_timeout: Timeout waiting for the shutter to move. Please ensure the device is properly connected and try again.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred during calibration. Please try again.
error.command_failed: The serial command could not be queued. Check the USB connection and logs.
error.invalid_raw_payload: Enter exactly 11 characters: 'ss' followed by 9 hexadecimal characters.
error.transmit_failed: The raw RF telegram could not be sent. Check stick status and logs.
error.invalid_status_identities: Enter each additional status identity as device_ID/enum, separated by commas or new lines (for example F2B8D5/23).
error.status_identity_incomplete: Enter both primary status fields or leave both blank.
error.status_discovery_unavailable: The USB stick is not connected. Reconnect it and try again.
error.status_discovery_busy: Another telegram recording is already running. Wait for it to complete and try again.
error.calibration_capture_busy: Another shutter's telegram recording is already using the shared recording slot. Wait for it to finish and try again.

abort.pairing_timeout: No device responded within 2 minutes. Please try again.
abort.pairing_interrupted_by_disconnect: Pairing was interrupted because the connection to the USB stick was reset or reloaded while waiting for a response (for example, by adding or editing a different shutter, or restarting Home Assistant). Please try again.
abort.command_test_successful: The motor command test was successful.
abort.device_not_found: The selected device could not be found. Please restart this step.
